subject: Life Skills
title: When a Breach Hits You
description: Learn When a Breach Hits You in one minute.

hook.text: Over 10 billion account records have been leaked in data breaches since 2013.

buildup.text: Companies store your data on servers. When those servers are hacked, your info leaks out.

discovery.text: Sites like Have I Been Pwned let you check if your email appeared in any known breach.

twist.text: Most people never check. They keep using compromised passwords for years without knowing.

climax.text: If you find a breach, change that password immediately and check other sites using it.

punchline.text: You can't stop breaches. You can limit damage.

quiz.question: What should you do first after a data breach?
options: Change the password and check for reuse
Wait for the company to fix it
